info.scr_teacher: 呂耀中,許宜珮,黎淑婷,李元榮,周郁森

description.sub_ename: AN INTRODUCTION TO ARCHITECTURE AND ENVIRONMENT
description.describe_ch: 本課程給建築新鮮人對建築之初步認識，並介紹現代建築的發展。強調環境變遷下永續建築之重要，體驗建築，並了解建築設計原理。首先要學生了解什麼是建築，建築的意義何在，其本質與環境之間的關係何在。
description.describe_eh:
This course focuses on the fundamental understanding of Architecture for beginners, the course also introduce the development of contemporary architecture. 
With the emphasis of the sustainable architecture, knowing the importance of architecture, and understands the design theories behind. Students will learn about the architectural manifestos, and the relationship between the nature of the architecture and its environment.

targets.describe_ch: 能了解建築相關領域之基本知識
targets.describe_en: Understands the fundamental of architecture related knowledge

weeklyScds.tpd_learn_en: Instructor: Yuan-Jung Lee Interior Space and Humanization: Students will learn how to create spaces that meet ergonomic and psychological needs through interior design. The course will explore the impact of furniture arrangement, lighting, color, and more on the indoor environment. Environmental Health and Air Quality: The course will focus on the impact of indoor air quality, temperature, humidity, and other factors on health. It will introduce how design can improve the indoor environment. Green Interior Design: Students will understand the principles and techniques of green interior design, including the use of green building materials and energy-efficient design, to create more sustainable indoor environments. Multi-Functional Space Design: The course will emphasize achieving versatility in limited indoor spaces and integrating different purposes into one space. Application of Natural Elements: Students will learn how to incorporate natural elements.

weeklyScds.tpd_learn:
授課教師:李元榮
  1. 陳設藝術原則： 學生將學習陳設藝術的基本原則，包括平衡、重複、對比等，並了解如何運用這些原則來營造具有視覺吸引力的室內空間。
  2. 色彩與材質選擇： 課程將探討色彩和材質在陳設藝術中的重要性，學生將了解如何選擇和組合不同的色彩和材質，以營造特定的氛圍和風格。
  3. 空間動線與功能性： 學生將學習如何通過陳設藝術來優化室內空間的動線和功能性，以提升使用者的體驗和舒適度。
  4. 故事性陳設： 課程將引導學生創建具有故事性的陳設，讓每個設計元素都能傳達特定的故事或概念。
  5. 展示和展覽設計： 學生將了解如何通過陳設藝術來設計各種展示和展覽
weeklyScds.tpd_learn_en: Instructor: Yuan-Jung Lee Principles of Display Art: Students will learn the basic principles of display art, including balance, repetition, contrast, etc., and how to use these principles to create visually appealing interior spaces. Color and Material Selection: The course will explore the importance of color and materials in display art. Students will learn how to select and combine different colors and materials to create specific atmospheres and styles. Space Flow and Functionality: Students will learn how to optimize the flow and functionality of interior spaces through display art, enhancing user experience and comfort. Narrative Display: The course will guide students in creating narrative displays, where each design element conveys a specific story or concept. Exhibition and Exhibition Design: Students will learn how to design various displays and exhibitions through display art.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Academic Integrity Statement: Academic integrity is of utmost importance in this course. Any form of plagiarism, unauthorized collaboration, or misrepresentation of another person's work constitutes a serious violation of academic ethics. All students must ensure that the assignments and projects they submit are their original work and adhere to proper citation standards, clearly attributing the use of external resources. If academic misconduct is detected, it will result in appropriate penalties, which may include the assignment or course being evaluated as failing.
Course Policies: Assignments: All assignments must be completed independently and not through copying or collaborating with others. If collaboration is needed, it must be approved by the course instructor. Citations: Proper citation is required when using external resources, including text, images, videos, etc. Failure to cite properly will be considered plagiarism and will be subject to corresponding penalties. Violation Review: Serious cases of academic misconduct will be reviewed by the course instructor. Penalties: The consequences of academic misconduct are severe and may include but are not limited to assignment failure or course failure. Please note that adhering to academic integrity and course policies is the responsibility of every student. Please maintain a honest and upright attitude throughout your learning process to ensure the authenticity and value of your academic achievements. Note: These course policies are subject to change, so please stay updated for any revisions.

policy.ais_meno_en:
Academic Integrity Statement: Academic integrity is of utmost importance in this course. Any form of plagiarism, unauthorized collaboration, or misrepresentation of another person's work constitutes a serious violation of academic ethics. All students must ensure that the assignments and projects they submit are their original work and adhere to proper citation standards, clearly attributing the use of external resources. If academic misconduct is detected, it will result in appropriate penalties, which may include the assignment or course being evaluated as failing.
Course Policies: Assignments: All assignments must be completed independently and not through copying or collaborating with others. If collaboration is needed, it must be approved by the course instructor. Citations: Proper citation is required when using external resources, including text, images, videos, etc. Failure to cite properly will be considered plagiarism and will be subject to corresponding penalties. Violation Review: Serious cases of academic misconduct will be reviewed by the course instructor. Penalties: The consequences of academic misconduct are severe and may include but are not limited to assignment failure or course failure. Please note that adhering to academic integrity and course policies is the responsibility of every student. Please maintain a honest and upright attitude throughout your learning process to ensure the authenticity and value of your academic achievements. Note: These course policies are subject to change, so please stay updated for any revisions.
